DESIGNED AROUND EXISTING EQUIPMENT

Less on your vest.
More in your glasses.

One familiar pair of glasses handles listening, speaking, and recording. The radio and connection hardware stay on your belt.

01

Everyday smart glasses

Built-in speakers deliver radio audio. Integrated microphones capture your reply. The onboard camera records your perspective.

02

Belt-mounted radio + adapter

A proposed adapter links the glasses to your existing radio for audio and push-to-talk. The radio stays clipped to your belt.

03

Recording + evidence connection

Associate glasses footage with the incident and queue encrypted uploads until connected. No separate body camera in the proposed setup.
